newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 8.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 8.

text.p: Latvian state radio had the following headlines on its noon news programme. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch their accuracy:
- The historic NATO summit opens in Madrid
- President Ulmanis has travelled to the summit and is to meet U.S. President Bill Clinton.
- Young Lithuanians picketed several sites in Madrid, asking that their country be accepted into NATO.
- The Baltic 1997 song festival has opened in Riga.
- The prosector's office is interested in the case of the Latvenergo credit from Banka Baltiya.
